rationale: The original long thesis relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($18.22) and the $18.20 support level, both of which have now failed. Exiting now avoids slippage on an imminent stop-out while avoiding a short flip directly into the rising session VWAP ($18.01) on a high-volume gap day.
